title: Network Delay Time
description: You are given a directed, weighted network of n nodes labeled from 1 to n. Each edge [u, v, w] means a signal takes w units of time to travel from u to v. A signal starts at node k. Return the minimum time required for every node to receive the signal, or -1 if any node is unreachable.
inputFormat: First line: three integers n, m, and k
Next m lines: three integers u, v, and w describing a directed edge
outputFormat: Print the time when the last node receives the signal, or -1 if not all nodes are reachable.

examples.explanation: Nodes 1 and 3 receive the signal after 1 unit, and node 4 receives it after 2 units.

title: Word Ladder
description: Given beginWord, endWord, and a dictionary, return the number of words in the shortest transformation sequence. Each step must change exactly one letter and every transformed word must be in the dictionary. Return 0 when no sequence exists.
inputFormat: Second line: integer n, the dictionary size
Third line: n space-separated dictionary words
outputFormat: Print the length of the shortest transformation sequence, or 0.
constraints: All words have the same length

examples.input:
hit cog
6
hot dot dog lot log cog
examples.explanation: One shortest sequence is hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog.

publicTestCases.stdin:
hit cog
6
hot dot dog lot log cog

hiddenTestCases.stdin:
hit cog
5
hot dot dog lot log
